integrity: The final claim was reconstructed algebraically from the cited fixed-temperature confidence boundary, checked symbolically and numerically, and compared against the primary source, a close contemporaneous framework, a classical precursor, and targeted database results. scientific_limitations: Optimizes a single constant temperature selected from a deterministic pre-data finite-horizon regret envelope. No post-hoc or data-dependent temperature validity is claimed, and no lower bound over all possible confidence-sequence constructions is claimed.
title: Exact horizon-optimal temperature for regret-based linear confidence sequences
